about.body: The Ford EcoBoost 2.0 — also known as the Ford GTDI — is a turbocharged 2.0-litre inline-four petrol engine. It was used by Land Rover as an alternative to the Ingenium petrol engine in earlier models, spanning three model lines: the Range Rover Evoque (L538, 2013–2019), Freelander (L359, 2013–2014), and Discovery Sport (L550, 2015–2019).

byModel.body: Across the Discovery Sport (L550, 2015–2019), the EcoBoost powered the Si4 variant. In the Freelander (L359, 2013–2014), the same Si4 badge covered the engine's short run in the model's final years. The Range Rover Evoque (L538, 2013–2019) used it throughout the first-generation model's lifecycle.

compatibility.body: Because the EcoBoost spans three different Land Rover models over varying production years — each with its own vehicle-specific ancillaries and mounting — compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model and generation, which we do by registration. An EcoBoost from an Evoque isn't necessarily a drop-in match for one from a Discovery Sport, even though it's the same base engine. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
compatibility.boldNote: We always confirm by registration/VIN before any rebuild or replacement.
